setup.script:
#!/bin/sh
# the conversation lock's launcher as run sees it: --status-fd N before the --, then the engine as its own child
fd=""; while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do case "$1" in --status-fd) fd=$2; shift 2;; --) shift; break;; *) shift;; esac; done
command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { [ -n "$fd" ] && [ -n "$STUB_WORD" ] && [ "$STUB_WORD" != none ] && echo "$STUB_WORD" >&"$fd"; exit 127; }   # the same on every sh: the shell's own "not found" line differs (dash and bash)
"$@"; rc=$?
[ -n "$fd" ] && [ -n "$STUB_WORD" ] && [ "$STUB_WORD" != none ] && echo "$STUB_WORD" >&"$fd"
exit ${STUB_RC:-$rc}
